plugin.name: G.A.M.MA / Anomaly
plugin.description: Arena map for GAMMA / Anomaly without Wormhole. Installs its own geometry, collision, AI-map and compatibility manifest. Choose exactly one map variant. Compatibility notices appear in-game; see ROSTOK_COMPATIBILITY.md for manual testing.

plugin.name: [Vasgen's Cozy Spots] Bar (Rostok) Expansion | Wormhole
plugin.description: Arena map matched to the locally tested Wormhole assets. Select only with Wormhole installed. A matching effective game graph/cross table is also required. Compatibility notices appear in-game. No external tools or online version checks are required.
